senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) orifice of the matrix; womb.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 16b">B. Bath. 16ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>רַחְמָהּ צר</he>, v. <cite ref="A01272"><he>אַיָּלָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 70a:17">Ḥull. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>כותלי בית הר׳</he> the sides of the womb; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37">Gen. R. s. 37</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 869:5">Yalk. Ps. 869</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 110:3">Ps. CX, 3</cite>) <he>מרַחְמוֹ של אולם שחרתיך לי</he> from the womb of the world (sunrise, east) did I choose thee for me.—Pl. <cite ref="T00526"><he>רְחָמִים</he></cite>. Ḥull. l. c.
